Compare exported plan/revision before and after; attach findings for every acceptance criterion.

b56fb8da-2746-5f32-b2d5-c121053aded2.title: Validate cross-domain internal test scenarios
b56fb8da-2746-5f32-b2d5-c121053aded2.objective: Use self-hosting and physical/procurement scenarios to ensure the engine is not accidentally restricted to software tickets.

acceptance.text: Add bounded internal software and procurement/manufacturing test scenarios with evidence and decision gates; keep self-host as the sole user-facing example.
Check next/explain, milestone completion, calendar/uncertainty interpretation and independent verification.
Mark all simulated fixtures as such; never treat fixture success as real project delivery.

steps.action: Specify bounded software and procurement scenarios with cross-project dependencies, multiple repositories, non-Git human work and portable resource references.
steps.expected_result: Each scenario names actors, evidence, dependencies, milestones and decision gates without copying a retired demo.

steps.expected_result: Both scenarios demonstrate the same engine semantics and label all data as simulated.

steps.expected_result: Tests and documentation explain what the simulated scenarios establish and what they cannot prove.

out_of_scope: Restore retired user-facing samples, build procurement-specific UI or claim synthetic work is real delivery.

Validate all test plans and run ./ci.sh; self-host remains the sole user-facing example.
Exercise one workspace spanning differently located repositories plus a non-Git human task, multiple immutable evidence sources and cross-project dependencies.
Verify checkout changes do not reset state; planning access alone must not imply access to external evidence.

fe0878f6-959c-5f45-8e79-eafc7c516999.title: Qualify the scoped alpha build
fe0878f6-959c-5f45-8e79-eafc7c516999.objective: Collect reproducible local and hosted quality evidence for the explicitly accepted alpha scope.

acceptance.text: Run formatting, Clippy, tests, strict docs and release build on the supported stable/MSRV platform matrix.
Review available dependency audit/license results and record unresolved findings accurately.
Publish a capability/non-goal checklist that does not claim server/auth/native products unless separately accepted.
Run the required license and advisory gates across every workspace package and all features; workspace metadata resolves to AGPL-3.0-only and exceptions never permit unrelated third-party crates.

steps.action: Freeze the accepted alpha capability/non-goal checklist and supported toolchain/platform matrix.
steps.expected_result: The qualification scope excludes deferred products and names reproducible build inputs.

steps.action: Run local and approved hosted formatting, lint, test, strict-doc and release gates.
steps.expected_result: Actual logs identify each passing/failing platform and toolchain without implied coverage.

steps.action: Review available dependency audit/license reports and publish unresolved findings with evidence.
steps.expected_result: A qualification record traces each claim to a check or explicitly documented limitation.

in_scope: Quality evidence for the approved alpha scope and supported platforms.
out_of_scope: Claim unrun platforms passed, add hosted services or treat unavailable audit tools as a clean audit.
verification: ./ci.sh on the declared toolchain; record stable/MSRV and platform results individually.
Run required cargo-deny license/advisory gates and inspect their output; unavailable or failed checks are not a clean audit.
Measure representative graph sizes before claiming scale; preserve revision-consistent queries and complete graph validation when optimizing.

1a7d5082-3223-5175-9f43-2534fc761577.title: Prepare the public alpha release evidence
1a7d5082-3223-5175-9f43-2534fc761577.objective: After acceptance, prepare reviewable versioning, changelog and public-repository artifacts with real commit/CI links.

acceptance.text: Verify luofang34/dpm is public and references the intended reviewed commits before claiming publication.
Preserve AGPL-3.0-only, document usage and limitations, and attach actual release evidence.
Respect repository permissions and explicit requirements for shared-history/tag actions; record any blocker rather than inventing success.
Registry/distribution availability is claimed only after verifying the published package, dependency order, release archives, checksums and supported target installation.

Describe only published installation paths and tested export guarantees; distinguish supported portable fields, omitted operation history and any loss report. Optional hosting or store packaging is not required for local operation.

steps.action: Inspect accepted qualification evidence, actual reviewed commits and public repository status.
steps.expected_result: Release prerequisites and blockers are explicit before publication claims.

steps.action: Prepare alpha version/changelog, demo commands and AGPL-3.0-only notices for the reviewed scope.
steps.expected_result: Reviewable release material accurately describes functionality, limitations and source provenance.

steps.action: Publish only through authorized repository actions and attach real public commit/CI/release links.
steps.expected_result: The public luofang34/dpm evidence identifies the intended source; blocked steps remain reported as blocked.

in_scope: Scoped public alpha preparation and authorized publication evidence.
out_of_scope: Change the license, make the target repository private, force shared history or create tags without required authorization.
verification: Check public repository visibility and resolve every linked artifact to the intended reviewed commit.
Re-run documented demo commands and applicable quality gates before publication.
Verify hosted CI against the intended source; local build or package inventory does not establish registry installation or unrun platforms.
Check package-manager name acceptance separately from GitHub naming; do not promise short upstream install commands without an actual accepted package.

973bf299-2998-54fa-a1dc-a58d2f66eff8.title: Specify operation/revision exchange
973bf299-2998-54fa-a1dc-a58d2f66eff8.objective: Define a minimal local/network sync boundary over semantic operations, with no CRDT bypass of domain invariants.

acceptance.text: Specify revision preconditions, identities, deduplication, conflict outcomes and validation order.
Describe LocalOnly behavior and an exchange contract suitable for a later server.
Test protocol examples without introducing a SaaS dependency.
Version the workspace/lineage, opaque revision, operation ID, principal/device and command/reason envelope; timestamps do not determine authoritative order.
Specify checkpoint plus operation recovery, durable pending/rejected proposals and tentative offline claims without treating wrapping local counters as global identity.

steps.action: Specify lineage-aware semantic envelopes, authoritative per-workspace ordering, durable outbox state and idempotent retries.
steps.expected_result: Protocol examples define accepted, duplicate, stale and invalid operation outcomes.

steps.action: Implement the reviewed local backend boundary and validation/conflict interfaces.
steps.expected_result: LocalOnly behavior exercises the same invariants expected from a later network adapter.

steps.action: Test exchange examples and document ordering, retry and failure semantics.
steps.expected_result: A server implementer can follow the contract without inferring raw Git or CRDT synchronization rules.

in_scope: Minimal operation/revision exchange contract and LocalOnly boundary.
out_of_scope: SaaS dependencies, full collaboration transport or CRDT writes bypassing domain validation.
Cross-workspace federation, raw SQL/page synchronization or compulsory hosted SaaS.
verification: Test accepted/duplicate/stale/invalid exchange examples and deterministic conflict responses.
Run ./ci.sh and compare resulting operations to engine validation outcomes.
Reject the same operation ID with different content and matching numeric revisions from different histories; recover gaps from a validated checkpoint.

0752410b-cd82-5af0-b289-e88a6138c82e.title: Separate principals from credentials
0752410b-cd82-5af0-b289-e88a6138c82e.objective: Prepare the server identity boundary for humans, agents and services with local/device/service credentials and future passkey/OIDC/Apple adapters.

acceptance.text: Keep vendor credentials separate from actor/domain identity.
Specify authorization of workspace operations and independent verification policy.
Test local credential rejection and principal attribution without building an account product.
Separate workspace permissions from repository/evidence access; bind authenticated principals at the service boundary and keep credentials out of shared locators and artifact URLs.

steps.action: Separate actor/principal identity from credential providers and document workspace authorization rules.
steps.expected_result: The contract accommodates human, agent and service actors without vendor-specific user identity.

steps.action: Implement the approved local/device/service credential boundary for the optional server.
steps.expected_result: Valid credentials attribute commands to the intended principal and invalid credentials fail closed.

steps.action: Test authorization and independent-verifier policy and document future provider extension points.
steps.expected_result: Passkey/OIDC/Apple remain adapters to a stable principal model, not implemented account products.

in_scope: Principal/credential abstraction and minimum approved server credential checks.
out_of_scope: Full account registration, production passkey/OIDC/Apple enrollment or identity derived from untrusted actor strings.
verification: Test absent/invalid credentials, wrong workspace permission and attributable accepted operations.
Check self-verification rejection under principal mapping; run ./ci.sh.
Reject spoofed actor strings, unauthorized workspace selection and credential-bearing shared configuration; preserve independent-verifier identity.

7b02eb97-e80f-56ee-a52c-33f492517ffa.title: Implement an approved minimal sync server
7b02eb97-e80f-56ee-a52c-33f492517ffa.objective: Implement the smallest approved HTTP query/operation adapter, reusing engine/store logic and the reviewed identity boundary.

acceptance.text: Support authenticated query and operation exchange with revision checks and typed conflict responses.
Demonstrate atomic validated persistence and clean shutdown on disposable storage.
Keep the storage/transport boundary explicit and avoid unimplemented collaboration promises.
Sequence accepted operations per workspace and atomically persist result/deduplication; portable database copies do not constitute enrollment.

steps.action: Read accepted SYNC-10/AUTH-10 contracts and define the smallest query/operation HTTP surface.
steps.expected_result: Each endpoint maps to an existing engine/service operation with explicit auth and revision errors.

steps.action: Implement the approved transport adapter and atomic persistence using shared services.
steps.expected_result: Authenticated operations preserve the same domain validation and revision outcomes as local clients.

steps.action: Run disposable-storage request/restart/shutdown tests and publish the working API contract.
steps.expected_result: Evidence demonstrates clean shutdown, typed conflicts and no partially persisted operations.

in_scope: Approved minimal authenticated HTTP query and operation exchange server.
out_of_scope: Full SaaS product, richer collaboration promises, business logic duplicated in handlers or platform UI.
verification: Use ephemeral 127.0.0.1:0 listeners to test valid/invalid auth, stale operations and restart persistence.
Exercise graceful shutdown and atomic failure; run ./ci.sh and shared adapter checks.
Retry an acknowledged operation without duplicating it; return the same typed conflict for stale proposals through each supported adapter.

9d92e316-9dd6-5d1c-8b2e-d876cb24aa1c.title: Verify multi-client collaboration invariants
9d92e316-9dd6-5d1c-8b2e-d876cb24aa1c.objective: Independently test the optional server with competing agents before considering richer collaboration.

acceptance.text: Exercise simultaneous/stale operations, duplicates, authorization failures and invalid graph changes.
Verify no operation is silently lost or accepted without its domain/revision checks.
Attach reproducible integration evidence and document transport limitations.

steps.action: Build independent clients against the optional server with controlled revisions and credentials.
steps.expected_result: The test harness coordinates concurrent events without fixed ports or sleep-based races.

steps.action: Exercise competing writes, retries/duplicates, stale revisions and invalid/unauthorized operations.
steps.expected_result: Every operation is accepted once or returns an explicit reproducible conflict/rejection.

steps.action: Inspect final state/history and attach integration evidence with remaining transport limitations.
steps.expected_result: No successful operation is silently lost and authoritative invariants survive concurrency.

in_scope: Independent multi-client correctness tests for the approved server.
out_of_scope: Build rich comments/presence, new transports or bypass checks to simplify concurrent tests.
verification: Use event synchronization and ephemeral ports; verify revision continuity and operation deduplication.
Test restarts and rejected invalid changes leave state intact; run ./ci.sh.
Race disconnected claims and accept only one owner; retain the rejected proposal for review rather than silently dropping it.
Restart with pending outbox work, reconnect, deduplicate retries and verify snapshot/checkpoint lineage and final accepted state.

46190a5d-e9f7-5102-be21-40f587988e97.title: Specify native/Web projection contracts
46190a5d-e9f7-5102-be21-40f587988e97.objective: Design stable query/view-model contracts suitable for SwiftUI, Web and Compose; do not build all platform products in this task.

acceptance.text: Map Today/Work/Network/Detail to existing query/command semantics and identity boundaries.
Document platform-specific UI freedom and optional Rust FFI boundaries.
Require separate implementation scope before selecting or building a production UI stack.
Work views expose contextual decisions with reasons/sources separately from blocking gates; pending collaboration state never appears as globally accepted ownership.

steps.action: Map Today/Work/Network/Detail user needs to current queries, commands and principal boundaries.
steps.expected_result: A platform-neutral field/interaction matrix identifies reusable data and unsupported requests.

steps.action: Specify versioned view models and optional Rust FFI/HTTP boundaries with error and revision handling.
steps.expected_result: SwiftUI/Web/Compose clients can interpret the same contracts without owning business rules.

steps.action: Review sample payloads and document native UI freedom and separate implementation decisions.
steps.expected_result: A reviewable API design exists without committing to or claiming a platform product.

in_scope: Native/Web projection contract design and sample payload review.
out_of_scope: Build multiple platform apps, select a production framework without scope approval or move authoritative state into UI.
verification: Compare sample payloads to engine queries and command/revision errors.
Walk through selection, detail, blocked work and independent-review scenarios using the proposed fields.

efdabaef-268c-5e7c-888b-0fee76b7df90.title: Bound rich text and CloudKit collaboration designs
efdabaef-268c-5e7c-888b-0fee76b7df90.objective: Specify optional text/presence and CloudKit boundaries as reviewed contracts and conflict examples while preserving validated execution state.

acceptance.text: Separate text/presence data from lifecycle, gates, dependencies and permissions.
Document offline/revision conflicts and native-platform constraints without claiming a transport implementation.
List resource/cost/portfolio/procurement extensions as future scope, not giant speculative enums.

steps.action: Identify which comments/presence data may merge independently and which execution fields require validation.
steps.expected_result: A boundary table excludes lifecycle, gates, dependencies and permissions from unrestricted CRDT updates.

steps.action: Describe offline operation exchange and CloudKit/native adapter constraints using the reviewed revision protocol.
steps.expected_result: Conflict examples preserve domain checks and distinguish optional transport from local authority.

steps.action: Capture deferred extension constraints in linked work/requirements and executable contract examples.
steps.expected_result: The plan states scope and acceptance without a second narrative roadmap or speculative domain enums.

in_scope: Design boundaries for optional rich text/presence and CloudKit integration.
out_of_scope: Implement CRDT/CloudKit transport, relax execution invariants or expand into full enterprise portfolio/resource management.
CRDT writes to lifecycle, dependencies, gates, ownership, acceptance or permissions; cross-workspace transactions and unmeasured large-portfolio claims.
verification: Review offline/conflict examples against semantic operation and authorization contracts.
Check that each proposed field has a clear owner and no text merge can change validated execution state.

8254702d-7eec-5e3b-b43a-ddb8aac44dee.title: Optional execution semantics and integration
8254702d-7eec-5e3b-b43a-ddb8aac44dee.objective: Group separately authorized semantic extensions; this branch is not a prerequisite of MVP or scoped alpha acceptance.

38a9835d-52b2-5497-ae3f-69212e23bbe2.title: Optional semantics independently accepted
38a9835d-52b2-5497-ae3f-69212e23bbe2.objective: Zero-duration condition: all incoming task/milestone prerequisites independently verified and applicable gates resolved.

f4b1c0af-11be-5ebd-b6d1-28b8433665f2.title: Identify dependency policies and non-gating work links
f4b1c0af-11be-5ebd-b6d1-28b8433665f2.objective: Represent independently addressable temporal constraints and explicit waivers without collapsing multiple constraints between the same tasks.

acceptance.text: Preserve simultaneous SS and FF bounds between one task pair; commands identify an edge unambiguously.
Only an authorized non-Agent actor may waive/restore a soft constraint with a nonempty reason; hard-edge changes require plan review.
RelatesTo/Duplicates/DerivedFrom/Supersedes links do not alter readiness, scheduling or progress.

steps.action: Give each dependency a stable identity and define hard/soft policy changes through reviewed semantic commands.
steps.expected_result: SS and FF may coexist between the same ordered task pair and can be edited independently.

steps.action: Implement explicit waiver and restoration for soft edges with authorized actor, time and reason; add typed non-gating work links.
steps.expected_result: Hard constraints cannot be waived; waived constraints are excluded consistently from readiness and remaining schedule projections.

steps.action: Expose policy and rationale through shared CLI/MCP queries and test rejected edits atomically.
steps.expected_result: Duplicate identities, stale revisions, missing endpoints and cycles fail without partial writes.

in_scope: Stable edge identities, explicit policies and reviewed soft waivers/restoration.
Non-gating contextual links with reference and duplicate validation.
out_of_scope: Provisional Submitted satisfaction, conditional joins, resource leveling or permissions product.

Test simultaneous SS+FF edges and CLI/MCP parity, including actor/ref/revision failures; run ./ci.sh.

57a54fb3-5649-5b80-ad69-82ca251af63a.title: Define actual execution events and enforce elapsed lag
57a54fb3-5649-5b80-ad69-82ca251af63a.objective: Distinguish reserving work from starting it and derive execution gates from explicit authoritative events, without inventing missing timestamps.

acceptance.text: A claim alone does not release SS; an explicit start event does. No model/engine wall-clock reads.
Test +23h/+24h at a 24h gate and a milestone whose decision resolves later than all predecessor verification events.
Unknown required event time blocks with an actionable reason; negative lag affects scheduling only and is explicitly explained.

steps.action: Specify Start, submission and verification events, positive/negative lag policy and gate completion times for milestones.
steps.expected_result: Claim remains reservation; a milestone completes at the last prerequisite or decision event required by its condition.

steps.action: Implement relation-specific claim/submit/verify gates with adapter-supplied time and structured unknown-event diagnostics.
steps.expected_result: FS/SS govern start and FF/SF govern finish; positive elapsed lag cannot be bypassed when event time is unknown.

steps.action: Test timing boundaries and aggregate conditions through the shared GateReport and all adapters.
steps.expected_result: All views and commands agree, including zero-duration milestones and delayed decision approval.

in_scope: Authoritative execution-event facts and deterministic elapsed-time gate evaluation.
Task and milestone endpoints; work packages remain containers, never dependency endpoints.
out_of_scope: Working-time lag calendars, backdated fabricated starts, operation-log scans during queries or stored derived readiness.
verification: Cover every dependency kind for claim/submit/verify with injected timestamps.
Verify event facts and revisions across restart, rejected commands and independent verification; run ./ci.sh.

5b81757e-b49d-5ad7-a6a6-33b72ec05a0b.title: Preserve provisional submission bases through rework
5b81757e-b49d-5ad7-a6a6-33b72ec05a0b.objective: Track the exact submission attempt used by downstream work so rejection cannot be hidden by a later submission.

acceptance.text: A1 Submitted -> B starts on A1 -> A1 rejected -> A2 Submitted/Verified leaves B flagged until explicit reviewed revalidation.
Submitted results never satisfy final verification gates merely because provisional execution was permitted.
Persist attempt and causal facts, not a cached invalidation flag; rejection history remains inspectable.

steps.action: Define stable submission-attempt identities and immutable dependency-basis references captured by affected operations.
steps.expected_result: Authoritative facts survive rejection/resubmission; basis-invalidated remains a derived condition.

steps.action: Implement explicit provisional edge policy and independent revalidation of invalidated downstream bases.
steps.expected_result: A later upstream submission or verification never silently validates a successor based on a rejected attempt.

steps.action: Test rejection/resubmission/revalidation across restart and concurrent revision conflicts.
steps.expected_result: Explain identifies the rejected attempt and affected downstream work without scanning operation history.

in_scope: Provisional dependency policies, attempt identity and causal basis evidence.
out_of_scope: Automatic cascading lifecycle rewrites, silently accepting new results as equivalent, CRDT conflict resolution.
verification: Compare all intermediate gates after restart, including repeated rejection and resubmission.
Exercise CLI/MCP parity and stale/rejected revalidation with unchanged state; run ./ci.sh.

be8e8ba3-64b5-5843-a26b-f1e1b1624567.title: Make conditional work and join rules explicit
be8e8ba3-64b5-5843-a26b-f1e1b1624567.objective: Support optional branches without treating skipped work as universally completed evidence.

acceptance.text: Supplier A/B merge accepts only the selected verified branch under an explicit active-branch join policy.
Conditions on work packages apply to descendant tasks; unrelated downstream work is not released merely by a skipped predecessor.
At least one applicable branch is required unless the join explicitly permits an empty result; unknown choices are not completion.

steps.action: Define decision options, applicability inheritance through containers and explicit join policies.
steps.expected_result: Normal dependencies and branch joins have distinct semantics; an all-skipped join cannot complete accidentally.

steps.action: Implement derived applicability and consistent readiness/progress/scheduling projections.
steps.expected_result: Unselected subtrees cannot be claimed; active join prerequisites must satisfy their declared policy.

steps.action: Test chosen, unknown and all-skipped paths and attempted choice changes after work starts.
steps.expected_result: Choice changes affecting in-flight work require reviewed plan change; unresolved alternatives are reported as scenarios rather than unsupported probability claims.

in_scope: Decision options, inherited applicability and explicit joins with consistent projections.
out_of_scope: Unconditional vacuous edge satisfaction, automatic cancellation of in-flight work, mixed-scenario P50 claims without a probability model.
verification: Exercise empty/all-skipped joins, nested packages and ordinary downstream dependencies as well as the A/B happy path.
Verify next, progress, CPM and Monte Carlo use the same active graph; run ./ci.sh.

baf6189b-1b2c-54df-80aa-58cb78bc415f.title: Add explicit workspace query scope without hiding blockers
baf6189b-1b2c-54df-80aa-58cb78bc415f.objective: Filter globally ranked work only after full-graph eligibility evaluation, with visible out-of-scope context.

acceptance.text: An out-of-scope dependency cannot become satisfied; filtered candidates retain global order.
A resource-less non-code task is outside a resource-only scope and appears in outside_scope if eligible.
Define higher_ranked_count relative to the highest-ranked in-scope result, or all eligible outside work when none is in scope.

steps.action: Specify membership rules for resource sets, project subtrees, capability sets and work without resources.
steps.expected_result: Resource scope requires a positive match; all write requirements must fit; project/resource filters intersect and capability eligibility is distinct.

steps.action: Implement a typed Next result containing applied scope, ranked candidates and outside-scope counts/keys.
steps.expected_result: All gates and scores use the full graph; limiting results occurs after scope filtering.

steps.action: Expose distinct CLI project-key filtering and matching MCP inputs; test no-code and multi-repository work.
steps.expected_result: --project continues to select a directory; outside_scope highlights eligible higher-ranked work rather than hiding it.

in_scope: Visible query-only scope and a versioned structured Next result.
out_of_scope: Changing claims or graph membership through filters, resource allocation/leveling or filesystem authorization.
verification: Test empty scopes, zero-resource tasks, read-only requirements, multi-write tasks and limits.
Compare CLI/MCP result objects and unchanged authoritative state; run ./ci.sh.

7ecf321a-a725-5fe1-89b1-0f1ee02fc525.title: Add provider-scoped external tracking references
7ecf321a-a725-5fe1-89b1-0f1ee02fc525.objective: Represent tracking context across hosted and self-hosted providers without making external issue states authoritative.

steps.action: Define provider-instance identity, namespace, object kind and stable external ID separately from display labels/URLs.
steps.expected_result: Equal numeric IDs from different instances or namespaces do not collide.

steps.action: Implement validated link/unlink commands and per-identity Tracks uniqueness through the shared engine.
steps.expected_result: Tracking links preserve local authority and cannot act as evidence or dependency satisfaction.

steps.action: Test namespace collisions, duplicate tracking ownership, rename-safe identity and adapter parity.
steps.expected_result: Explain exposes context while next, schedule and verification remain unchanged.

out_of_scope: Live connectors, token storage, automatic assignee writes or imports that bypass review.
verification: Test identical provider IDs from separate self-hosted instances and link removal without graph changes.
Compare CLI/MCP and snapshots before/after failed changes; run ./ci.sh.

29cb3968-83c3-5658-bc13-c0eaf044f4e8.title: Bound project interchange and connector proposals
29cb3968-83c3-5658-bc13-c0eaf044f4e8.objective: Implement only an explicitly supported interchange subset with observable losses and semantic review.

Missing acceptance imports as Proposed; issue closure or source percent-complete cannot verify local tasks.
External parsers/connectors do not link incompatible dependencies into shipped binaries or mutate the store directly.

steps.expected_result: Supported fields and unsupported/lossy mappings are explicit; opaque field retention is not a universal round-trip guarantee.

steps.action: Map imported work to proposed contracts and preserve source identities without bypassing acceptance or verification.
steps.expected_result: Summary dependencies use validated task/milestone anchors; imports produce semantic diffs at an observed revision.

steps.action: Test proposal review, identity mappings, unsupported fields and round trips against source fixtures.
steps.expected_result: Reports distinguish preserved values, approximations and rejected data; external parsers remain optional isolated adapters.

in_scope: Approved interchange subset, mapping tests and reviewed import proposals.
out_of_scope: Universal lossless MSP/MPP/Primavera conversion, mandated sidecar technology, full resource leveling or remote SaaS dependencies.
verification: Use external golden fixtures; test source IDs, milestones, constraints and unmapped-field reports.
Run license/advisory checks and full ./ci.sh; verify failed imports preserve operations and revision.

6138f172-2971-5cd1-8515-520f6b61be0a.title: Explainable work selection
6138f172-2971-5cd1-8515-520f6b61be0a.statement: An agent discovers eligible leaf tasks from next with reproducible ranking, capability constraints and explicit gates.

50625c7b-d065-5188-a522-bb9fb78eb203.title: Executable task context
50625c7b-d065-5188-a522-bb9fb78eb203.statement: An agent reads objectives, observable acceptance, requirements, dependencies, risks and source context from explain without guessing references.

56af87d0-71ea-5575-bc04-f070a8e9191e.title: Immutable development evidence
56af87d0-71ea-5575-bc04-f070a8e9191e.statement: A real implementation commit and its relevant test/review evidence can be attached to the matching task; an uncommitted working tree is not represented as a finished commit.

4d0b0655-1b34-5b15-b7c7-eb4748c998f7.title: Independent acceptance
4d0b0655-1b34-5b15-b7c7-eb4748c998f7.statement: Submission is distinct from verification; only a different authorized reviewer can accept a result and unlock its downstream tasks.

bf2a0e85-cd71-5fff-87ad-f66a8591a269.title: Terminal projection
bf2a0e85-cd71-5fff-87ad-f66a8591a269.statement: The operator can inspect task hierarchy, remaining Gantt hours, milestones, dependency types and progress, and navigate without modifying the execution graph.

087248db-f9e4-5c27-968d-c2b539178037.title: Graph and persistence correctness
087248db-f9e4-5c27-968d-c2b539178037.statement: Commands preserve validation, stable IDs, revision checks and atomic operation/snapshot persistence; UI and agent adapters own no domain rules.

f334b834-595d-5136-af46-0b308c643c81.title: Safe plan evolution
f334b834-595d-5136-af46-0b308c643c81.statement: Versioned semantic proposals, history/diff and append-only revert enable roadmap changes without database replacement or raw Git merges.

e1682222-b5c1-5fef-9ccd-81d9e40abde8.title: Honest scheduling
e1682222-b5c1-5fef-9ccd-81d9e40abde8.statement: Temporal constraints, calendars and uncertainty remain explicit inputs; CPM, Monte Carlo and percent-complete projections never become authoritative schedule state.

430279b8-809d-5dbf-9795-4b698c09aa6e.title: Validated collaboration
430279b8-809d-5dbf-9795-4b698c09aa6e.statement: Collaboration exchanges validated semantic operations and checkpoints within a workspace lineage. Bind principals to authentication, validate base revisions, deduplicate stable operation IDs, retain pending/rejected proposals and return explicit conflicts. Git, SQLite file copying and CRDT text merges cannot bypass domain invariants.

bd186e65-ccd7-5720-abd2-1c75c67da7f6.title: Explicit stage authorization
bd186e65-ccd7-5720-abd2-1c75c67da7f6.statement: This seed is planning only. Broad roadmap entries, provisional estimates and existing source references are not execution authorization, completed work or release evidence.

2493971c-2616-5deb-b3a6-750e7d826522.title: Repository-independent workspace identity
2493971c-2616-5deb-b3a6-750e7d826522.statement: A workspace is one validated graph containing nested projects and code or non-code tasks. Stable workspace, project and task IDs survive checkout moves and repository renames; cross-project edges are validated together. Work-package containment stays within its project.

ab68d6d6-0145-554f-980b-c5bb2bd4514b.title: Portable resource references and local bindings
ab68d6d6-0145-554f-980b-c5bb2bd4514b.statement: Tasks may reference zero, one or multiple resources. Shared resource IDs are independent of remote URLs and device-local checkout paths. Explicit locators select one workspace across repositories; ambiguous bindings fail and context filters are visible. Resource references do not count as completion evidence.

2d5a1316-0b52-5ddc-aecc-23d92a73ec8b.title: Lossless versioned plan interchange
2d5a1316-0b52-5ddc-aecc-23d92a73ec8b.statement: TOML and JSON encode the same versioned interchange model independently of locator, API and storage schemas. Preserve supported authoritative values and IDs; exclude derived views, credentials and local bindings. Import validates and proposes changes at an observed revision without replacing live history or bypassing lifecycle verification. Before publication, migrate bundled inputs directly to the selected format rather than retaining legacy adapters; unsupported formats fail explicitly and live databases are never silently replaced.

c79a01b2-9102-5dce-9b1b-f67d67972424.title: Durable operational state and recovery
c79a01b2-9102-5dce-9b1b-f67d67972424.statement: SQLite holds durable standalone state or a collaborative replica with pending operations. Text exports may be stale and omit history; startup never rebuilds live state from them. Recovery preserves checkpoints, operation lineage and unsent work; active database files are not a file-sync protocol.

2202b173-92fd-52d8-a2a2-d94275a7a48f.title: Decisions consumed with work
2202b173-92fd-52d8-a2a2-d94275a7a48f.statement: Explain returns relevant requirements and decisions with their rationale, source and status. Context associations do not gate execution. Reviewed decision replacement preserves prior rationale and identifies affected work for reassessment; source discussion or a recorded choice is not implementation or execution authorization.

fcdcae00-adad-5569-b4fb-926602835c87.label: Prepared-only self-host scope and milestone guide

4b8243e7-0435-52dd-99db-d080846956c6.label: Workspace design discussion; not implementation or acceptance evidence

b0d5a43d-1ada-5322-ba2d-a6f235c5d211.label: Release preparation constraints; historical check results are not current evidence

c49ffca1-1b01-5e2b-9954-18971c07312e.question: When has the user explicitly authorized starting the self-host tasks? This prepared seed must remain query-only until that separate instruction.

a7fb9363-39af-5e46-a1a1-2b05baa9fff4.question: Which source commit, operational workspace and independent reviewer are explicitly selected for the live self-host cycle and publication evidence?

a62796ee-1095-5fea-b048-0335309c39b5.question: Which later terminal layout scope is explicitly accepted after the MVP review? No layout work is authorized by this seed.

f1751454-e429-554c-add8-96aca3db1998.question: Which roadmap phases beyond TUI MVP and agent-understandable/operable work are approved? Core expansion, server/sync/auth/native UI remain deferred.

7d520a23-dcd3-5334-b325-7c385cfe2ca1.question: How do projects spanning repositories and non-code work share state?
7d520a23-dcd3-5334-b325-7c385cfe2ca1.outcome: Use one workspace graph with multiple entry points. Repository/resource identity is separate from local bindings; Git discovery boundaries remain conservative.
7d520a23-dcd3-5334-b325-7c385cfe2ca1.rationale: Checkout layout differs between users and must not fragment project dependencies or create independent writable copies of the same workspace.

6b66a3f5-abe1-5d84-9b98-0bcc5a5ed9ae.question: What role do TOML and JSON have relative to operational state?
6b66a3f5-abe1-5d84-9b98-0bcc5a5ed9ae.outcome: Use TOML for human plan interchange and JSON for the same machine model. Keep locator configuration separate; apply imported edits as validated semantic proposals.
6b66a3f5-abe1-5d84-9b98-0bcc5a5ed9ae.rationale: Reviewable text is useful for sharing, but an edited or stale export cannot safely overwrite lifecycle, independent verification or operation history.

3e1bbddb-282e-5557-a40a-a00cd39c2298.question: Is SQLite a disposable hot copy of a plan file?
3e1bbddb-282e-5557-a40a-a00cd39c2298.outcome: Keep SQLite as durable local operational storage, including pending work in collaborative mode. Use consistent backups for recovery and semantic operations for synchronization.
3e1bbddb-282e-5557-a40a-a00cd39c2298.rationale: The latest committed or unsent actions can exist only in the local store; neither an older text snapshot nor copying a live main database file preserves that record.

b76b00cd-d98c-5526-b73b-e30ebf17cff8.question: How should the first collaboration protocol order competing changes?
b76b00cd-d98c-5526-b73b-e30ebf17cff8.outcome: Use one logical sequencer per workspace, durable client outboxes and explicit revision conflicts. Offline claims are tentative until acknowledged; no automatic stale-command merge.
b76b00cd-d98c-5526-b73b-e30ebf17cff8.rationale: Equal numeric revisions can have different histories, and disconnected agents cannot guarantee exclusive ownership. Conservative validation gives a testable first protocol without mandatory SaaS.

946a3b57-6bf1-52c9-a2d6-b26f77a92592.question: Where should durable planning choices be consumed?
946a3b57-6bf1-52c9-a2d6-b26f77a92592.outcome: Store constraints and concise choices in linked requirements/decisions; put future work in task contracts and implementation evidence in artifacts. Read them through explain rather than a parallel narrative plan.
946a3b57-6bf1-52c9-a2d6-b26f77a92592.rationale: A decision needs an execution-time reader, scope and replacement handling; changing a prose document into a different file format does not keep it current.

6ef69bbe-d99a-52fb-a141-c459bd0c3e8e.description: A broad reference roadmap may be mistaken for permission to implement deferred features.
6ef69bbe-d99a-52fb-a141-c459bd0c3e8e.mitigation: Keep DEC-EXECUTE and phase gates open; do not interpret planning data or estimates as authorization.

b683bb26-0d39-52e9-a283-6b2c93dcc082.description: Uncommitted MVP source or local check reports may be misrepresented as independently verified/public release evidence.
b683bb26-0d39-52e9-a283-6b2c93dcc082.mitigation: Distinguish contextual source artifacts from acceptance evidence; establish a real commit and independent review.

cf654136-d86c-5ad9-99e2-2dd5b817fe88.description: A requested task/dependency edit or recovery workflow may exceed the operations exposed by the installed version.
cf654136-d86c-5ad9-99e2-2dd5b817fe88.mitigation: Keep this seed reviewable. Do not overwrite live SQLite; use separately approved validated copies for plan authoring until CORE-20/30 are accepted.

56dcce46-6933-5a78-ab22-618ae1133687.description: Provisional O/M/P values and elapsed-hour projections may be mistaken for calendar commitments or resource-leveled dates.
56dcce46-6933-5a78-ab22-618ae1133687.mitigation: Re-estimate before execution; show units and uncertainty. No capacity, calendar or delivery promise is implied.

ad10cfce-3f4f-5646-8cd5-c1c1369eb84f.description: Local actor names can be impersonated and do not provide authenticated independent review.
ad10cfce-3f4f-5646-8cd5-c1c1369eb84f.mitigation: Use trusted separate reviewer processes now; add explicit credential/authorization boundaries only in the approved later scope.
